description: Prepare a zip of the workspace's chat media (one folder per chat), or get the download link of a finished one. Call without exportId to start an export; call with exportId to get a 10-minute download link once it's ready. Zips are kept for 72 hours.

dueForRemoval.description: Only media that retention removes within the next 7 days.

exportId.description: An export started earlier; returns its download link when ready.

name: neuron_download_media
title: Download Media
